Schwab Sector Views is our six- to 12-month outlook for stock sectors, which represent broad sectors of the economy. The Schwab Center for Financial Research (SCFR) combines a factor-based approach with a market and economic assessment to determine the ratings. For the basics on sectors, please see Stock Sectors: What Are They? How Are They Used?

## Sector views [...] Not much changed during the past month. Financials, Energy and Materials remain Outperform, while Real Estate and Consumer Discretionary remain Underperform. Although Real Estate is 7th in the rankings, we maintained its Underperform based on weak fundamentals, including high interest rates and vacancies. Communication Services ranks near the bottom by factors, but we’ve maintained an override partly because the sector is dominated by a few stocks that we rate highly. Information Technology has [...] Table shows the Schwab Center for Financial Research's ratings for the 11 equity sectors. Currently, Financials, Energy and Materials are rated outperform. Real Estate and Consumer Discretionary are rated underperform. Industrials, Utilities, Consumer Staples, Health Care, Communication Services and Information Technology are rated Marketperform. 

Source: Schwab Center for Financial Research, as of 7/26/2024.
